declared_limits_kept: The generated oracle still recomputes its expectation with the same primitives the implementation uses, so a definitional drift between SCOPE and code can only be caught by the hand-written contract tests. This round moved four such drifts into contract tests; it did not remove the structural risk.
Fenced blocks, setext headings and mid-read changes stay declared out of scope; the ninth review checked them and found them consistent, so the exclusion did not hide a defect.
The no-op control proves the harness distinguishes NOT_A_CHANGE from SURVIVED; it cannot prove that no other substitution is behaviourally inert, because inertness is not computable from text.
